title: Finite coefficient integration from the two components of the model trace
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_integral_of_components
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (t : Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (g : completedUnit l S ⟶ t.Rc.R.obj ((completedLine l X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (n : ℕ)
    (hcomponents :
      let E := ULift.{u} (Padic l)
      let V := t.restrictionS.F.mapDerivedCategory
      let ev := ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalMod l S)).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
      ∃ β : (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S).obj (completedUnit l S) ⟶
          ev.obj (V.obj ((SpTowerClasses.line l E t.chernS)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)),
        (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S).map g ≫ t.toPresentation.sourceMap l E ≫
            (t.LS.projection n).app _ ≫ ev.map (t.varying.inv.app _) =
          β ≫ ev.map (V.map (t.model.twistedUnit l E)) +
            (t.coefficientsS.unitMap l E t.LS ≫ (t.LS.projection n).app _) ≫
              ev.map (V.map (t.model.chernAdjoint l E))) :
    (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S).map (g ≫ t.trace) ≫
        ((diagonalCompletedRestriction l S).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalMod l S) 0).map
          (t.coefficientsS.coefficientProjection.app (op n)) =
      ((diagonalCompletedRestriction l S).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalMod l S) 0).map
          (t.coefficientsS.coefficientProjection.app (op n))

proof.text: Use diagonalTrace_twistedSplitting_components for the two arrows into the twisted direct image. They identify the twisted unit and relative Chern adjunct with the two twisted biproduct inclusions followed by the twisted splitting and twisted-pushforward isomorphism.

Expand the definition of Model.trace. The twisted-pushforward isomorphism cancels its inverse, and functoriality brings bq next to its inverse. Cancel them using Result.split. The remaining biproduct equations inl_snd=0 and inr_snd=identity give the two assertions; the positive-unit and contraction isomorphisms preserve zero and identity.

Under exact restriction and evaluation, apply these two trace-component equations to the assumed base-plus-Chern sum. The base term vanishes and the Chern term becomes the projected coefficient unit. Functoriality identifies the evaluated tail with systemTrace.

Use Result.reductions to identify this projected composite with the projection of the completed trace. Apply the normalized exact-cone projection theorem to the coefficient cone and postcompose the equality by the two canonical single-object comparisons. This gives the literal ordinary coefficientProjection in the conclusion.
